title: Crazy Ex-Girlfriend is truly one of the most underrated shows of all ...
transcript: So you may not know this about me, but I'm actually a massive Crazy Ex-Girlfriend stan and so when it was announced that Rachel Bloom was doing a solo show Off-Broadway, I knew I had to get tickets! And like first of all, can we just appreciate how incredible this artwork is. I'm so obsessed with it, I am hanging it up on my wall immediately. Back to the show, the show definitely did not disappoint! And for me it really solidified that I am going to see anything that Rachel Bloom is involved in, because I really think she's a genius. Much like Crazy Ex Girlfriend before it, the show does a really good job balancing humour and musical comedy with deeper, serious issues. And as you may have been able to glean from the title, this is a show that deals with death, and specifically the way that we grieve and mourn. It's a deeply personal piece from Rachel Bloom, but she still manages to keep it super light and funny, and in traditional Rachel Bloom fashion delivers some really really funny comedy numbers. There is one song in the show in particular that I cannot stop thinking about, it is so funny, and it may just be my favorite song Rachel Bloom has ever written that's how good it is! And while I obviously knew that the show was going to be very very funny, I was not expecting to be as moved as I was. And that is the genius of Rachel Bloom, she will have you laughing one second, crying the next, and then laughing immediately after. It’s truly an emotional roller coaster, and I wish that I could talk about it more, but there are so many fun surprises in the show that I feel like saying anything more will feel too spoiler-heavy and I wanna keep this review spoiler-free. So if you're in New York City, I highly recommend checking out Death Let me do my Show, and if you're not, I believe this was filmed in LA and at some point will be on streaming, and I highly recommend checking it out once it is!
